provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: the 1862 Pustet prints 'DEus,' for 'DEUS,' (capitalisation only); AT WORDS 3-3: typica 'sacramenta' vs the 1862 Pustet 'sacram6nta,'; AT WORDS 5-5: typica 'UniJLgeniti' vs the 1862 Pustet 'Unigeniti'; AT WORDS 7-8: typica 'gloriosa Transfiguratione' vs the 1862 Pustet 'glori6sa Transfigurati6ne,'; AT WORDS 10-15: typica 'testimonio roborasti, et adoptionem filiorum perfectam,' vs the 1862 Pustet 'testim6nio roborsti, etadoptionem fili6rum perf6ctam,'; AT WORDS 17-17: typica 'delapsa' vs the 1862 Pustet 'delpsa'; AT WORDS 19-19: typica 'nube' vs the 1862 Pustet 'nuoe'; AT WORDS 22-23: typica 'praesignasti: concede' vs the 1862 Pustet 'praesignsti concde'; the 1862 Pustet prints 'propitius' where the typica prints 'propitius;' (pointing only); AT WORDS 26-26: typica 'ipsius' vs the 1862 Pustet 'lpsius'; AT WORDS 28-28: typica 'gloriae' vs the 1862 Pustet 'gl6riae'; AT WORDS 30-30: typica 'coheredes' vs the 1862 Pustet 'cohseredes'; the 1862 Pustet spells 'ejusdem' where the typica spells 'eiusdem' (orthography/accent only); AT WORDS 34-34: typica 'gloriae' vs the 1862 Pustet 'gl6riae'; AT WORDS 37-37: typica 'consortes.' vs the 1862 Pustet 'cons6rtes.'; AT WORDS 39-40: typica 'enndem Dominum.' vs the 1862 Pustet 'eumdem D6minum.'; AT WORDS 5-5: typica 'UniJLgeniti' vs the 1922 Mame 'Unigeniti'; AT WORDS 7-7: typica 'gloriosa' vs the 1922 Mame 'gloriesa'; the 1922 Mame prints 'Transfiguratione,' where the typica prints 'Transfiguratione' (pointing only); AT WORDS 9-10: typica 'patrum testimonio' vs the 1922 Mame 'patrumtestimonio'; AT WORDS 13-13: typica 'adoptionem' vs the 1922 Mame 'adoptidnem'; AT WORDS 20-20: typica 'lucida,' vs the 1922 Mame 'licida,'; AT WORD 22: the 1922 Mame reads 'preesignasti', typica reads 'praesignasti:' [ocr]; AT WORDS 28-28: typica 'gloriae' vs the 1922 Mame 'gloriz'; AT WORDS 33-34: typica 'eiusdem gloriae' vs the 1922 Mame 'ejuisdem glorize'; AT WORDS 39-40: typica 'enndem Dominum.' vs the 1922 Mame 'eumdem Deminum.'. Corroboration: Two independent public-domain witnesses were read for every oration: the Pustet Ratisbon 1862 whole-book text layer and the Tours: Mame 1922 editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam (artifact ia-scan-pdf-9873693a), the latter reconstructed column by column from its page word bounding boxes. The Vatican typica 1604 and Venice 1570 were swept but not relied on (both are registered degraded-latin and their records forbid resting a claim on a raw search over them).. Recorded limitation: || REPAIRED by lane repair-2 on 2026-09-03. The stored target had been a text-layer reading carrying recogniser damage; it has been replaced word for word by a reading taken from the 1962 CMAA facsimile page image at 400 dpi (artifact PDF p. 695, printed folio read on the same image). Line-end hyphens are joined, printed stress accents are dropped, and the ae/oe ligatures are expanded to two letters; punctuation, capitalisation and the conclusion are reproduced at the length the page prints them. The verdict, the antecedent locus and the recorded differences are the original lane's and were not revisited. The marginal number 3270 already in the locus was confirmed on the same 400 dpi image.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui fidei sacramenta in Unigeniti tui gloriosa Transfiguratione patrum
testimonio roborasti, et adoptionem filiorum perfectam, voce delapsa in nube
lucida, mirabiliter praesignasti: concede propitius; ut ipsius Regis gloriae
nos coheredes efficias, et ejusdem gloriae tribuas esse consortes. Per
eundem Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Oblata, quaesumus, Domine, munera gloriosa Unigeniti tui Transfiguratione
sanctifica: nosque a peccatorum maculis, splendoribus ipsius illustrationis,
emunda. Per eundem Dominum nostrum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Praesta, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut sacrosancta Filii tui
Transfigurationis mysteria, quae solemni celebramus officio, purificatae
mentis intellegentia consequamur. Per eundem Dominum nostrum.
